Notes: 
 * One of the channels in the dpa4023 tape was 
   littered with static.  I took the clean channel
   to mix into the dpa4028 to see if it added 
   clarity.  
 - At some point someone grabbed the stand and 
   the top segment fell.  I quickly lowered it,
   reoriented the mics and raised it back up.  
   I didn't try to hide the noise, it will be 
   most noticeable if wearing headphones.
 - Thanks for Kenny for the ticket and the lift
